title: Will trick you into paying £12.99 upfront!!!
body: Just been charged £12.99 after signing up to a free trial. Luckily I was given a refund when I reported this. From previous reviews, I see that this has been an ongoing problem for months which has not been resolved. Will delete this app now.
author: TillyPlymouth

title: Commitment overload
body:
AUDHD diagnosed and money is always tight. 7 day trial and then £39.99 is a lot to ask for us ND people to try. 
We will forget, probably ignore reminders and then you take payment we fight to get it back and thus then cannot eat for a day or 2. It’s literally such a frustrating system and when we try to get money back apple will just tell us no, give an excuse this has happened to me more times than I can count. If this was made for ADHD you would know this would be an issue or barrier for most. Financially, memory etc … just really frustrating
author: arfa92

title: Tricked into paying for a year
body:
I planned to trial this for the 7 days free with no payment however the way the app is set up it works it so if you’re not careful you end up not getting the trial and end up paying for a year upfront. I didn’t want to subscribe yet. 

Be very careful when signing up as to not fall into the same trap.

title: Scam People who really needs help
body: It’s disrespectful you try to charge so much money in something we can not even try! You force us to commit for at least 1 month even if we take the 7 free days. Won’t even try it cause is not a trustful system. It should be like Lumosity, for me the best brain train app til now, they let you play some games and you choose to pay for get more.

title: Not a free trial
body: If you charge more for taking the trial (£39.99 a year) than you do if you don’t take the trial (£34.99) it’s not really a free trial is it? You’re actually charging me £5 more for trying the game before I commit.
author: Vryko

title: Annoying mandatory surveys
body:
I don't want to answer your long drawn out boring on boarding questions.

I just want to play and not fill in your forms. What part of attention deficit do you not get?
author: wtf9871234987124

title: what a joke
body: what an absolute joke of an app, this doesn't help with anxiety and adhd it just wants your money. the fact i went through the test answered the question only to get to the end and it wants you to pay to find out the results is insulting . and the price is extortionate. no idea how this got 5 stars other than false reviews
